{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-hi-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"791f6b80651735a38e1848e2187e4cf6d26066fbc020a2099fbf264abb379b94","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-hi-class-3:lineage:104","source_registry_sha256":"1323c0f691f132d6e9e9a263c68306b972b82c8bbaa5a48a33a79177660764be","source_liveness_sha256":"27cf6d56fae2d5323c61bcbb69f0d992aeceb71a7dae4302b1f14baa17651cb0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Licensing of Drivers: Exemptions, Identity, License Types and Minors","heading":"C2 — KG hints for Licensing of Drivers: Exemptions, Identity, License Types and Minors","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — KG hints for Licensing of Drivers: Exemptions, Identity, License Types and Minors

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A04
An instruction permit can be issued at fifteen and a half, while a provisional license requires age sixteen and one hundred eighty permit days [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint licensing-ages; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F35 and sec01-F38.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A04
A provisional license comes at sixteen after the permit period, while a class three license requires age seventeen and completion of the graduated program for anyone under eighteen [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint licensing-ages; prereq_hint sec01-R01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F27 and sec01-F38.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A04
The permit-holding requirement is one hundred eighty days [A04], while the provisional-holding requirement before class three is six months [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint licensing-periods; prereq_hint sec01-R01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F24 and sec01-F11.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A04
By day a permit holder may ride with any licensed driver aged twenty-one or older, but between eleven at night and five in the morning the companion must be a parent or guardian [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-driving; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F22 and sec01-F36.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
The supervising driver must sit in the right front seat in every vehicle except a motorcycle, where no seat rule applies [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-driving; prereq_hint sec01-R04; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F22 and sec01-F26.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
A REAL ID compliant license works as federal identification [A02], while a limited purpose license allows driving only and proves nothing for federal purposes, employment, voting or benefits [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint identity-documents; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F15 and sec01-F29.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
A REAL ID license may normally be renewed by mail with an in-person visit every sixteen years, but a holder with temporary legal presence must renew in person every time [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint identity-documents; prereq_hint sec01-R06; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F16 and sec01-F17.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
For a new REAL ID license or instruction permit, provide original or certified documentation of legal name, date of birth, lawful presence and social security number, plus two proofs of your principal Hawaii address [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint identity-documents; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F14 and sec01-F19.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A01
A court suspension bars licensing only for the suspension period, while drunk driving while unlicensed bars licensing for two years [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint licensing-bars; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F06 and sec01-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A01
A license from another state or a Canadian province exempts you outright, while a foreign license needs an International Driving Permit and lasts only one year from arrival [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint exemptions; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F03 and sec01-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A05
Class one covers mopeds and class two covers motorcycles, and each needs its own knowledge and off-street skills tests [A02], while class three is the car license [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F25 and sec01-F26.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A04
A provisional driver may carry one non-household passenger under eighteen, while household members under eighteen are not limited [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-driving; prereq_hint sec01-R02; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F40 and sec01-F37.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0013]
